detail.title: How do I take a clear photo for the clinic?
detail.body: Use even, bright light such as daylight and avoid strong shadows and flash glare. Hold the camera steady, fill most of the frame with the area to be looked at, and tap to focus before taking the photo. Take the photo before applying products to the area unless your clinic tells you otherwise. If the app says the photo is not clear enough, retake it.
